From: Maya Patel <maya@founderspark.dev>

Date: 2026-03-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Incubator sponsorship offset and usage smoothing

Hi Rachel,

Quick one — the FoundersPark incubator recently committed to the Redwood sponsorship package (thank you again). Our finance team is asking whether the sponsor credit can be applied against the one-time onboarding/admin fee on invoice #FP-3043, and whether we can smooth sandbox credits across the first three months instead of a lump allocation in month 1.

Practically, two asks:
- Can we apply $6,000 of sponsorship credits to the onboarding/admin charge?
- If we accept credits pro-rated across months (50% month 1 / 30% month 2 / 20% month 3), will Redwood align consumption/metric reporting so it matches our forecasting?

I attached a quick sponsorship summary for context. If you need the PO or an updated SOW to proceed, I can get those over today.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
FoundersPark — Programs Lead
Attachment: sponsorship_summary.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@founderspark.dev>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incubator sponsorship offset and usage smoothing

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and congrats on the cohort!

We can accommodate both asks but there are a couple of routing/ops steps to make it clean for accounting. High level options (pick one):

1) One-time offset + straight allocation
   - Apply $6,000 credit to onboarding/admin invoice (FP-3043) as a one-time line-item credit.
   - Sandbox credits remain as a month-1 allocation (no smoothing).
   - Fastest path; requires AP confirmation + SOW amendment.

2) Pro-rated credit schedule (your 50/30/20 split)
   - We change the internal allocation so monthly reporting reflects the pro-rated amount.
   - We issue a credit schedule amendment to the SOW and map consumption quotas accordingly.
   - Requires a formal SOW amendment (DocuSign) and a short ops lead time (~5 business days).

3) Hybrid: apply $3k to onboarding now and convert the remaining $3k into an extended sandbox credit pool that we drip across three months.

Recommended: Option 2 if you want bookkeeping to match forecast; Option 1 if you need a quick payroll/invoice clean-up.

Next steps I can take: generate a SOW amendment and allocation matrix for your review (I attached a draft allocation_matrix.xlsx). If you can confirm PO # and which option you want, I’ll loop in Ben for approval and have Ops (Irene) raise the finance ticket.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachment: allocation_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks Rachel — looping in finance ops (Irene) for the ticket and the DocuSign flow.

Maya — quick note on approvals: I’ve authorized a one-time 20% onboarding fee offset (capped at $6,000) for this sponsorship and I’m supportive of the pro-rated allocation so your usage numbers align with your forecast. To proceed we’ll need:
- Confirmed PO number from FoundersPark (line item OK)
- Final SOW sign-off for the allocation schedule (Irene will add the amendment)
- HubSpot deal confirmation so we can keep the discount in the audit trail (see link below)

I attached a short approval note for internal records. Once we have the PO + SOW amendment, Finance can apply the onboarding credit and we’ll map the sandbox credits to your requested 50/30/20 split.

Ben Carter
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
